# Priyanka Kamath

> Priyanka Kamath is a technology leader with 10+ years leading technology risk
> functions — including regulatory compliance, AI risk, and trust — at global
> technology companies including Amazon, Flexport, and Wipro. She operates at the
> intersection of risk strategy, governance, product, and technical leadership,
> helping organizations ship transformative technology while protecting users,
> developers, and enterprises from emerging and evolving threats.

## Facts

- Current role: Software Development Manager, Amazon, Vancouver, Canada (since June 2025)
- Team: 11 engineers owning core components of the Amazon & AWS Compensation product, which serves 1M+ Amazon employees
- Prior employers: Amazon (Seattle, Arlington, Vancouver), Flexport, Open Juice Technologies, Fidessa, Wipro Technologies
- Education: M.S. Computer Science, University at Buffalo (SUNY), 2015–2017; B.E. Electrical & Electronics Engineering, NMAM Institute of Technology, 2009–2013
- Contact: kamathp@amazon.com · https://www.linkedin.com/in/priyankakh/ · mobile available upon request

## Selected results

- Shipped Manager Conversation Coach and Compensation Explainability for the 2026 Annual Compensation cycle, used by 400K+ Amazonians across managers, compensation consultants, and HR partners.
- Owns the roadmap to integrate AI natively into Amazon's Compensation Calculations platform.
- Launched a zero-to-one Finance Customer Contact Center product with 12 engineers, growing adoption from 10 to 300 users and scaling the platform 4x within a year.
- Set the security strategy for AWS Systems Manager products (Patch Manager, Systems Manager Agent) securing EC2 and hybrid instance patching for 5MM+ customers.
- Expanded Patch Manager across multiple AWS accounts and regions, adding ~$20M in annual revenue.
- Led a 25-person organization covering worldwide regulatory reporting, denied party and PEP screening, and suspicious activity monitoring across Amazon Stores, AWS Marketplace, and Amazon Gift Cards.
- Delivered the regulatory software required to launch Amazon.pl, Amazon.nl, Amazon.se, and AWS Marketplace across Europe.
- Replaced manual anti-money-laundering SQL rule-writing with machine learning models, removing $1.05M in annual cost.
- Brought Amazon Stores' regulatory services into GDPR and CCPA compliance, avoiding an estimated $5–25M in fines.
- Built the KPIs and UX integrations behind Amazon Brand Registry's growth to ~130,000 brands and $3B+ in sales.
